description: Gares du réseau ferré d'Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by L'Institut Paris Region. [Situation 2016] Ce jeu de données représente l’ensemble des gares voyageurs et/ou frets (SNCF et RATP) d'Île-de-France. Les gares fermées au service mais dont le bâtiment est toujours présent sont également dans la couche. Consulter la métadonnée. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Transports en commun, Transport, Gare, Train, RER, Transilien. The portal shows 493 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
